name: Spoken by the storm
about: Your words made out of pouring rain, with thunder rolling all around.

name: Spoken by fire
about: A crackling fire speaks your words in flickers and pops.

name: Spoken by the ocean
about: Waves breaking on the sand form every word you say.

name: Spoken by the wind
about: Your words carried and shaped by gusting wind.

name: Voice in the thunder
about: Your voice poured into rolling thunder, rumbling off the hills.

name: Words made of raindrops
about: Every word patters out of drops of rain on glass.

name: A crowd speaks your words
about: A murmuring crowd of strangers somehow says exactly what you say.

name: Engine for a throat
about: An idling motor rumbles and chugs out your sentences.

name: Whirlwind voice
about: Your voice melted into a little whirlwind that spins round and round your head.

name: Half you, half the sea
about: Your voice and the surf blended so you can't tell where one stops.

name: Voice of the blizzard
about: A thin, icy voice made of the snowstorm itself, howling round you.

name: Volcano speaking
about: A deep, rumbling molten voice, half of it fire, growling up out of a volcano.

name: Church organ speaks
about: A pipe organ in a stone church plays the shape of every word.

name: Words of a floating choir
about: A soft synth choir breathes out your words and lets them float away.

name: Voice of glass
about: Every word rings like a wine glass, thin and shining.

name: Voice of a bell
about: You speak and a church bell answers with the same words.

name: Singing bowl
about: A brass singing bowl hums and glows with every word.

name: Voice inside a gong
about: Your words shimmer and swell inside a huge bronze gong.

name: Wind chime mouth
about: Each syllable knocks a set of wind chimes tinkling across both ears.

name: Music box throat
about: A tiny music box comb plinks along inside your voice.

name: Steel drum speech
about: Your words struck out on a bright, bouncing steel drum.

name: Struck metal sheet
about: A big sheet of steel rings and wobbles with every word in a factory hall.

name: Voice of hollow wood
about: Knocking, hollow wooden tones, like a talking marimba box.

name: Bell-mouth vowels
about: The harmonics pulled out of tune, so every vowel clangs like a bell.

name: Singing wine glasses
about: Wet fingers on wine glass rims sing out the shape of your words.

name: Crystal voice
about: Only the brightest notes of your voice stay, ringing like crystal.

name: Voice of ice
about: A brittle, glittering voice made of a few frozen notes in an ice cave.

name: Down a long humming pipe
about: Your voice hums down a long metal pipe, the tube ringing low.

name: Strings that speak
about: A harp of tuned strings rings along and plucks with every word.

name: Buzzing drone strings
about: Low drone strings with a buzzing bridge hum underneath your voice.

name: Piano with the pedal down
about: Shouting into an open piano with the pedal held, every string answering.

name: Comb-filter choir
about: Your voice tuned into a major chord, like a choir singing your words.

name: Eerie tuned comb
about: A low, uneasy chord rings through every word.

name: Whole-tone dream strings
about: High strings tuned in a floating dream scale shimmer around you.

name: Ringing metal chord
about: A hard, clanging seventh chord rings out of every syllable.

name: Harp in the clouds
about: A high harp rings out your words and floats them up into a heavenly echo.

name: Clashing cluster strings
about: Strings tuned a step apart clash and beat against your words.

name: Granular swarm
about: Your voice broken into a buzzing swarm of tiny pieces.

name: Pixel rain
about: Bright digital specks of your voice raining down all over.

name: Backwards grain mist
about: A haze of tiny backwards pieces of your voice drifting in a big space.

name: Cloud of syllables
about: Whole syllables float around and overlap in a slow murmuring cloud.

name: Gravel shards
about: Gritty little chips of your voice, like gravel pouring out of a bucket.

name: Grain harp
about: Fluttering pitched grains of your voice strum a high harp.

name: Particles circling your head
about: A cloud of voice particles orbiting round your head on headphones.

name: Deep grain sludge
about: Big, slow, low lumps of your voice oozing over each other.

name: Hummingbird particles
about: Fast, high, darting specks of you, like hummingbirds zipping past.

name: Storm of grains
about: A wild storm of grains flying forwards and backwards in every direction.

name: Popcorn syllables
about: Little pitched pops of your voice bursting here and there like popcorn.

name: Talking through sand
about: Your words trickle through as grains of sand blowing across a dune.

name: Swarm of tiny yous
about: Eight tiny copies of you all talking at once, everywhere.

name: Frozen voice
about: Moments of your voice catch and hang in the air, frozen and ringing.

name: Endless stretch
about: One sentence stretched four times longer into a slow, glowing cloud.

name: Smeared dream
about: Every word smears into the next like a voice heard in a dream.

name: Frozen vowel dust
about: Held vowels crumble into a glittering dust of tiny grains.

name: Breath stretched into fog
about: A whisper drawn out so far it becomes a soft drifting fog.

name: Moments caught in ice
about: Long frozen chords of your voice glinting like ice under the words.

name: Slow shimmering cloud
about: Stretched three times slower, then lifted into a shimmering heavenly tail.

name: Melting voice
about: Your voice slows, sinks and smears like wax melting in the sun.

name: Every word lingers
about: Each word hangs on for a moment after you've moved on to the next.

name: Glacier talking
about: An enormous, impossibly slow voice groaning like moving ice.

name: Mirror world
about: Your voice flipped inside out: lows become highs, like a scrambled radio.

name: Inside-out voice
about: Mirrored high up, then dragged down, so your words sound turned inside out.

name: Skeleton voice
about: Only the strongest notes of your voice left standing, thin and bony.

name: Only the air left
about: The notes taken out and only the air around them left, wispy and faint.

name: Spectral glitter
about: Sparkling flecks of high notes scattered over your words.

name: Hollow combed voice
about: Regular gaps cut through your voice so it sounds hollow and tubey.

name: Stained glass voice
about: Coloured bands of your voice held and glowing like light through a church window.

name: Slid sideways
about: Every frequency slid up by the same amount, so your voice turns metallic.

name: Sunk below itself
about: Every frequency dragged down, leaving a murky, rubbery, wrong-sounding voice.

name: Squeezed harmonics
about: The notes inside your voice crushed closer together into a dull, odd hum.

name: Stretched harmonics
about: The notes inside your voice pulled apart, still your words but strangely metallic.

name: Half mirrored
about: Your normal voice and its upside-down mirror image talking together.

name: Broken memory
about: A worn recording of you, phrases out of order and parts gone missing.

name: Data corruption
about: A file falling apart: glitches, crunch and chunks of sound gone missing.

name: Bad video call
about: A wobbly, swirly video call breaking up out of a laptop speaker.

name: Underwater internet
about: A starved internet call that sounds like it's coming from under the sea.

name: Packet loss puppet
about: Half the sound lost, the gaps filled with jerky repeats like a puppet on strings.

name: Buffer overflow
about: Old pieces of sound spill over the new ones and roll faster and faster.

name: Corrupt music file
about: Squashed into the tiniest file possible four times over: swirling and watery.

name: Copied a hundred times
about: A copy of a copy of a copy, on tape and file, until it barely holds together.

name: One-bit voice
about: Your voice squeezed down to just on and off, a raw buzzing outline.

name: Skipping disc
about: A scratched disc that skips and sticks at random moments.

name: Call keeps freezing
about: An internet call that keeps grinding to a halt and lurching back into speed.

name: Tape dying as it plays
about: A chewed tape slowly giving up, sinking and slowing as it goes.

name: Radio from another dimension
about: A broadcast leaking through from somewhere else, spiralling and mirrored.

name: Your parallel-universe self
about: You and a slightly wrong copy of you, never quite in step or in tune.

name: Portal interpreter
about: Two shifted voices translating you through a humming portal.

name: Endless spiral
about: Each echo climbs a little higher, spiralling up and up forever.

name: Sideband ghost
about: Your voice slid far up into a thin, glassy, inhuman ghost.

name: Slow beating warp
about: Two copies of you a hair apart in tune, slowly beating like a warped tape.

name: Behind the mirror
about: Mirrored sound and backwards syllables from the far side of the glass.

name: Coming from everywhere at once
about: The same voice coming from every direction at once, swirling.

name: Time flowing backward
about: Played backwards with echoes trailing after, as if time had turned around.

name: Static from the void
about: A breathy whisper hissing through a radio tuned between stations.

name: Upside down and backwards
about: Flipped inside out and played in reverse, a language from nowhere.

name: Insect wings
about: Your voice flutters at the speed of beating insect wings.

name: Liquid voice
about: A voice that pours and ripples like water running over glass.

name: Electric razor throat
about: A harsh electric buzz chopping through every word like a shaver.

name: Buzzsaw throat
about: Folded and ringing until your voice snarls like a saw blade.

name: Folded inside itself
about: Your voice folded over on itself again and again, swirling and tangled.

name: Bubbling tar voice
about: A deep, thick voice glooping and bubbling up from a tar pit.

name: Voice made of static
about: Your words formed out of pure crackling noise.

name: Fizzing voice
about: Your voice fizzing and spitting like a freshly opened soda.

name: Liquid metal throat
about: A ringing metal voice that ripples and flows like molten chrome.

name: Rubber band voice
about: A voice stretched and twanged like a rubber band.

name: Shape-shifting voice
about: Pitch, size and vowels all drift slowly, never the same person twice.

name: Vowel carousel
about: Your mouth slowly turns through every vowel while the words go on.

name: Every vowel wrong
about: Vowels jump to random shapes many times a second, garbling every word.

name: Voice with two throats
about: One throat two octaves down and another an octave up, talking together.

name: Sinking through the floor
about: Your voice slides down two octaves while sinking below you.

name: Rising into the sky
about: Your voice climbs higher and higher, floating up over your head.

name: Speech on a staircase of notes
about: Your words hop between random notes of a dreamy scale, twelve a second.

name: Rubber throat
about: A throat that slowly stretches into a big wide wow and back.
